name: What if I have a specific material or design I don't want to change during value engineering?

mainEntity.name: What if I have a specific material or design I don't want to change during value engineering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your preferences for specific materials or design elements are central to your customized renovation, and AKN Design Group respects these choices during the value engineering process. If there's a particular feature you are committed to, we will work around it, focusing on other areas where efficiencies can be achieved without compromising your non-negotiable selections. Our approach is to enhance functionality and value while staying true to your unique vision, ensuring clear communication and a managed process that prioritizes your satisfaction and investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you have specific material or design preferences, AKN Design Group will prioritize them, focusing value engineering efforts on other areas to maintain your vision.
